note: Cutscene scripts. Each line id is also its voice file name: public/audio/voice/<id>.<ext>, listed in public/audio/voice/manifest.json. seconds is the target time on screen; a longer voice recording stretches its line. No spoilers: these lines never name a suspect or a solution.

lines.text: On a stormy coast lie the Saltreach Isles.
For years, the great lighthouse kept their waters safe.
Three nights ago, its light went dark.
And out on the black water, the pirates noticed.
Every captain gets a small island and a few coins.
Build, trade, and hold the line until the light burns again.
Welcome to Saltreach Harbor.
Trade, place your bets, and meet the other captains.
Click. The Keeper's Lock turns.
The sky outside your window was the right answer.
Inside lies a brass key for the lighthouse lamps.
When the armada comes, three captains must light them together.
One lamp. Two lamps. Three.
The great beam sweeps across the water.
It finds the pirate flagship, and the flagship burns.
The coast is safe tonight. Well fought, captains.
This little island is yours, captain.
Build a cannon. The pirates are coming.
The last ship sinks beneath the waves.
Your island holds. Collect your loot.
The pirates break through and sail off with their plunder.
Build stronger walls, and ring the bell again.
Sails on the horizon. The whole armada is coming.
Every captain, to Pirate Point!
Man the cannons, and get ready to light the lamps.
